subject: Pilot packaging: tier toggle scenarios and feature bundling
messages:
From: Leah Moreno <leah@careflux.io>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-07-19T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Packaging guidance for pilot — tier vs add-ons?

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We want to scope a 3-month pilot to validate inference latency and embedding quality across a small user cohort. Before we lock the PO I need clarity on packaging:

- If we start on the Compact tier with a few add-on features (sandbox, longer retention for logs) how easy is it to bump to the Throughput tier mid-pilot? Any proration or credit mechanics?
- Conversely, if we start on Throughput for initial speed and later want to drop features to save costs, what does downgrade look like operationally and financially?
- We have strict procurement timelines so a clear pricing example (pilot cost, upgrade credit, expected monthly after prod) would help.

Baseline signals: ~120k tokens/month during pilot, peak bursts up to 2k tpm for short windows, and ~50k embeddings/month (batch).

Appreciate a short options memo and next steps.

Cheers,
Leah Moreno
Head of ML Platform
CareFlux

Attachments: none

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Leah Moreno <leah@careflux.io>
Cc: Tom Evans <tom@careflux.io>
Date: 2025-07-19T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Packaging guidance for pilot — tier vs add-ons?

Leah — thanks for the clear notes and the traffic numbers, that helps a lot. I sketched two pragmatic paths depending on your priority (speed vs unit economics):

Option A — Start Compact + Feature Add-ons (cost-conservative)- Compact tier for baseline throughput; add Sandbox and Extended Logs as add-ons.- Mid-pilot upgrade to Throughput allowed with credit for unused Compact commitment (prorated by days remaining). Example: if you commit to Compact for the month and upgrade on day 12, we credit remaining pro-rated Compact spend toward the Throughput monthly commitment.- Good if you want to minimize upfront.

Option B — Start Throughput (performance-first)- Throughput tier reserved capacity gives steadier latency and better burst handling.- Downgrade window: 30-day notice and pro-rated refund toward future credits (not immediate cash refund). If you expect sustained production after pilot, this reduces operational risk.

Pricing anchors (illustrative, final numbers require a PO/seat count):
- Pilot (Compact + add-ons): ~$3,200/month for your reported baseline (includes 50k embeddings).
- Pilot (Throughput): ~$6,500/month reserved (lower per-token cost, higher base).
- Pilot discount: we typically offer a pilot discount up to 25% depending on committed timeline and case study agreement.

I attached a short memo with tables and a sample proration calculation (Redwood_Pilot_Packaging_Options_v1.pdf). Can you confirm whether CareFlux prefers low upfront vs guaranteed performance? I can set up a 30-minute call to walk through numbers and a draft SOW.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_Pilot_Packaging_Options_v1.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-07-19T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Packaging guidance for pilot — tier vs add-ons?

Hannah — quick pricing and negotiation guidance:

- Pilot discount: authorize up to 20% discount for a 3-month pilot without requiring manager sign-off. For anything >20% we need a deal manager escalation.
- Upgrade credits: use pro-rated calendar-day credit on committed monthly fees (not on usage overage). Formula: (remaining_days / total_days_in_month) * committed_monthly_fee. Apply credit toward next-month Throughput commitment.
- Downgrade policy: 30-day notice; refund as account credit using the same pro-rata formula; no immediate cash refunds.
- Add-ons: Extended Logs is an add-on and billed monthly at line-item rate; Sandbox is free for pilots under 3 months.

For CareFlux numbers (their baseline): recommend proposing Option A with a 15% pilot discount and an explicit upgrade path to Throughput with credit as above. Also include a $2k one-time migration/trial support credit if they sign within 30 days of this proposal (to accelerate procurement).

I'll populate the price sheet and SOW template, linking them to HubSpot.

-Ben

Attachment: CareFlux_PriceSheet.csv
